_meta.purpose: Specification of the synthetic 1,000-asset Korea test portfolio built by scripts/build_sample_portfolio.py. Every asset is SYNTHETIC: random locations inside official SGIS 시군구 boundaries, random values. It exists to exercise the portfolio / asset-class / 시도 loss curves with a balanced class mix — it is not a real portfolio and its numbers are not a market estimate.

location_rule: Pick a 시군구 uniformly at random (each of the SGIS sigungu units equally likely), then a point uniformly at random inside its official polygon (rejection sampling in EPSG:5179, then to WGS84). Uniform per unit, not per km², so dense urban units are not swamped by large rural ones.

asset_classes._note: Classes are the JRC sectors of physical_risk_config.json property_type_to_jrc_sector; the property types listed must map to their class (checked by tests/test_sample_portfolio.py). Counts are split as evenly as the total allows.
